_readme: THE APPS THIS FRONT COMPOSES — and from here on it is YOURS, like every other file here.
It is the same format as the list a Forge instance keeps for its kernel images, plus `surface`, which
says which Forge front this project is a copy of. Everything under `src/lib/**/generated/` is DERIVED
from this file by `npm run codegen` (the `forge-surface-codegen` command, which `npm run build` calls
for you). `npm test` fails while a generated file disagrees with this list.
TO ADD AN APP — one of ours or one of your own — install its package and add the entry. An app of your
own has to be PACKED and installed like any other: this front renders an app by importing it, so an
app that only exists as a directory in another repository cannot reach this build. The run refuses,
naming it, rather than rendering nothing.
AN APP THAT RUNS IN THE KERNEL NEEDS NO ENTRY. A payment driver, a job, an event script: it reaches
this front through the port, as data, and belongs on the instance list your kernel images are baked
from — not here. This list is only about components this build has to compile in.
★★ THIS COPY WAS CUT BEFORE THE TOOL EXISTED, so this file was written by hand on 2026-09-13 rather
than by `pnpm pack:surface`. It is the same derivation the cut makes — every app of the instance list
this project can IMPORT — so it holds the platform apps this fork installs plus `demo-gate`, which is
this box's own app and arrives as a directory (`file:../apps/demo-gate`) instead of a tarball.
`chrome` and `content` are on the box's list and NOT here: this fork does not depend on them, and an
entry naming a package `npm install` never fetched is exactly what the generator refuses.
